notes.title: v1.82Update
notes.content:
1. Reduce the loss of gold coins caused by failed levels, allowing everyone to quickly accumulate equipment and improve their experience.
2. Improved the bullet life when the Ancient Disk breaks out. For the boss's magic weapon, since there are too many mobs to block the damage to the boss, the penetration has been improved a bit.
3. Fixed the bug that caused the archive to not be deleted when opening a new game. Thanks to Yi Ye Qingzhou.
4. Fixed the bug that caused the store to get stuck after buying out. Thanks to the Speaker of Beasts for the bug.
